receipt.public_excerpt:
ARC-AGI avoids this by restricting itself to core knowledge priors,
those cognitive building blocks that are either present at birth or
acquired very early in human development with minimal explicit
instruction

evidence_items.explanation: ARC deliberately avoids acquired and cultural knowledge, so factual knowledge is not tested. This supports the factuality part.

evidence_items.locator: Section II.3.1, Core Knowledge list, first bullet (p. 47)

receipt.public_excerpt:
Objectness and elementary physics: humans assume that their environment should
be parsed into “objects” characterized by principles of cohesion

evidence_items.explanation: ARC is built on core-knowledge priors such as objectness and elementary physics, which are basic commonsense intuitions. That cuts against 'common sense aren't even addressed', though only the most basic layer is covered.

receipt.public_excerpt: Lastly, a major focus with ARC-AGI-2 is to investigate deeper levels of compositional generalization — the ability to combine known rules or concepts in novel ways.

evidence_items.explanation: The ARC authors describe ARC-AGI-2 as probing 'deeper levels' of compositional generalization than the 2019 ARC-AGI-1 design. That implies ARC-AGI-1 covered shallower levels, not none. The same section says most ARC-AGI-1 tasks needed only one high-level transformation, so coverage was weak.

unresolved_gaps: No source measures how much of ARC-AGI-1 requires combining rules.
Whether core-knowledge priors count as 'common sense' in Marcus's sense is a matter of definition.
